assertions: Transcript, boundary, turn, attribution, and utterance mismatches are source-addressed.
Every proposal retains supporting and contrary evidence.
All required repair actions are represented by strict contracts.
Automated word reassignment and source mutation are prohibited.
Ambiguous or overlap-affected evidence is preserved or marked unresolved.
Accepted decisions create sealed predecessor-linked successor records.
Rejected and deferred decisions cannot create successor records.
Persistence is deterministic, reloadable, cache-safe, and tamper-evident.
CLI operations expose conflict, proposal, successor, decision, and validation flows.
limitations: Synthetic rules qualify mechanics rather than repair accuracy.
Accepted successors project changes but do not yet assemble a replacement utterance view.
Word reassignment requires explicit later review evidence.
